scope: Sole-integrator editorial review: input versus PK parameters, variable distribution and clearance, interpretation and limits of TDM, current EUCAST and selected adult sepsis2026 recommendation.

conflicts.resolution: DAB3: citation overlay hides central labels; only visible image text read. Excluded from fully read and integrated pages. Article DOI10.3390/pharmaceutics16091137 identified; not read in full, original figure not inspected independently.
Membrane synthesis label not imported. EMA5.1 supports membrane binding/depolarisation for daptomycin, not a generic synthesis mechanism for all membrane-active drugs.
APP-II21 and RANG general innocuity language not transferred as dose escalation or absence of adverse effects; selective toxicity separated from clinical safety.
APP-II22–24: current EUCAST I is susceptible increased exposure, not uncertain intermediate or resistant. Exposure not reduced to larger dose; no dose instruction.
APP-II24 lysis equivalence corrected using EMA daptomycin mechanism. Static/cidal not used to rank efficacy or declare immune defenses irrelevant.
APP-II22/24: broad spectrum not equal activity against every Gram positive/negative isolate. Scope, isolate, site and exposure distinguished.
APP-II24 never-use wording replaced with common MIC versus distinct MBC measurement, consistent with KATZ1032; no routine MBC recommendation.
APP-II21 places nitrofurans among30S inhibitors. This figure is not an independent authoritative target catalog; no such mechanism imported, no illustration republished.
PDF935 final trimethoprim sentence continues936. Whole visible page read; continuation and quantitative selectivity not inferred. RANG ebook print-page labels not invented.
Only named intervals read. Other FarmacoI/II lessons and contributions from other lecturers not newly read for this introductory batch. Broader reconciliation remains open.
Gram stain and morphology separated; example photographs do not establish that every coccus is Gram positive or every rod Gram negative.

DAB8 three-layer shorthand reconciled with KATZ909 and RANG952: outer membrane, periplasm containing peptidoglycan, cytoplasmic membrane distinguished. Porins are compound-dependent channels, not unrestricted access for every hydrophilic antibiotic.

DAB10 MIC heading does not turn a disk diffusion photograph into a direct MIC measurement. EUCAST selected method and calibration passages support diameter in mm versus concentration and combination-specific interpretation.

DAB10: disk-diffusion plate photographs do not provide readable disk identities and ruler graduations or sufficient method metadata. Partial page excluded from complete reading and integration; no diameter or MIC inferred.
RANG951: body text read, embedded raster table not fully verified; conservatively counted as partial and excluded from integration.

KATZ908 generalized carbapenem beta-lactamase resistance caption, historical units/regimens, RANG952 sulfonamide-use list and prasugrel classification not imported or independently validated. APP-II25 PK/PD targets, guaranteed cure wording and historical TDM availability claims excluded from this envelope/test-method scope.
KATZ909 ends mid-word before PDF910; only completed mechanism text and complete figure43.3 used. KATZ907–908 and APP-II25 fully read as visible pages but not integrated. Continuations not inferred.
Embedded figure credits (Tortora1989 and McGraw-Hill) recorded privately; underlying originals not independently inspected. No source image reproduced.

DAB12: visible educational text inspected, historical report includes obscured metadata. Conservatively classified as partial; excluded from complete page count and integration. No patient data, report values, original image or case-specific reinterpretation published.
DAB11: schematic serial dilution and subculture illustration read; no concentrations, validated bactericidal endpoint or universal incubation duration inferred. Original diagram not reproduced.

DAB13 reduced clinical susceptibility to a blood concentration threshold tied to therapeutic index. EUCAST setting process combines microbiology, exposure at infection site, PK/PD and clinical data; no simple universal ratio imported.
DAB14 tenfold definition not imported as a rule. ECOFF describes the upper end of a species-agent wild-type MIC distribution; WT/non-WT is distinct from S/I/R.
DAB15 and APP-II22–24 separated by date from current EUCAST definitions. Historical intermediate is not relabelled retroactively as increased exposure; no historical patient report reclassified.
EUCAST aggregated distributions are not used to infer local resistance prevalence or comparisons across places or time.

DAB16–17: historical S/I/R diagrams have overlaid callouts obscuring chart details. Visible headings and text inspected, but pages classified as partial and excluded from complete reading and integration. No historic numerical breakpoint or underlying dataset reproduced.

DAB18 and DAB20 have identical normalized extracted text but different visual emphasis (host versus drug). Both PDF positions inspected; one repeated text, no distinct new synthesis or integration. The general triad was already covered.

NICE CG183 selected official indexed recommendation text consulted; direct HTML/PDF fetches returned 403. Full current page and complete guideline not verified; limitation retained. CDC and EMA pages directly consulted for the relevant claims.
Resistance, allergy and other adverse reactions separated. Historical label neither accepted as a complete diagnosis nor removed without assessment. No home challenge or dose advice.
EMA renal/myopathy passages illustrate overlapping organ risk despite minimal CYP involvement; pregnancy evidence gap not presented as demonstrated safety.

DAB23: numeric survival threshold and24h duration not validated as a universal bactericidal definition; excluded. Static/cidal effects and molecular targets are not treated as interchangeable classifications.

DAB25: text layer empty; visible labels read directly in the raster diagram. Underlying original and dataset unidentified; only qualitative educational meaning used, no numeric kinetics or efficacy inference.
DAB22 and APP-II24 Gram-only spectrum shorthand expanded: species coverage and isolate susceptibility remain distinct.
DAB21 and APP-II24 read with KATZ1032 and selected current UKHSA guidance; oral feasibility is not automatic suitability. No uniform IVOS protocol.
Cost compares appropriate options; historical cheapest-first wording not imported. Product-specific storage example does not generalize instructions to other formulations.

DAB26: automated text contains only the Andes2004 attribution; all diagram labels read in the image. Underlying article and original figure not independently reviewed; AUC is not drug mass and peak/MIC is not a concentration difference.
DAB27–28: numerical class targets and overlapping drug lists are not validated universal prescriptions. No numeric targets, antifungal regimens or class-wide monitoring rules imported.

DAB29 and APP-II26: post-antibiotic effect distinguished from slow systemic elimination. Low cell penetration, protein binding and once-daily administration not generalized across concentration-dependent agents.
DAB30 and APP-II25–26: time dependence does not guarantee cure or automatically justify continuous infusion. No infusion protocol, dose or regimen imported.
APP-II26 embeds versions of DAB28–29: separate PDF page and surrounding prose read, repeated figures not independent evidence. Prior APP-II25 rechecked in text but still not separately integrated.

DAB32 and APP-II27: numerical age-related renal decline and mandatory dosing interval for amoxicillin/clavulanate are not imported. Administration frequency does not establish a PK/PD category; changing input in a linear model does not itself change clearance.

DAB33: extracted text includes cycling/pre-emptive strategies absent from the visible table. All eight visible table rows and footer read directly; hidden list not used as clinical recommendations. Table footer credits Current Opinion in Critical Care18(5),October2012; article and original table not independently identified or read. Only qualitative PK concepts integrated.

DAB34–35: TDM efficacy, safety and resistance suppression are aims, not universal proven outcomes. Historical intermediate terminology reconciled with current EUCAST I; measured exposure does not change MIC or reclassify R.

KATZ1033, printed1013: entire visible portion of table51.1 read in image, including cells missing in extraction. Historical empirical regimens excluded from integration. Table continues on1034; continuation and footnotes not read or inferred.

SSC2026 official page: selected adult sepsis/septic-shock TDM recommendation consulted; conditional, very-low-certainty evidence. Full guideline and linked evidence tables not reviewed, no extrapolation to all patients or antibiotics.
